categories.main_business_segments: East Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three strategic business segments: smart power (including UPS/EPS, power supplies, communication power, high-voltage DC power, special power supplies, battery systems, power gateways, and cloud management platforms), data centers (modular data centers, containerized mobile data centers, customized industry data centers, intelligent power distribution, environment monitoring systems, precision air conditioning), and new energy (energy storage systems, PCS, EMS, BMS, sodium/lithium battery cells and PACK, photovoltaic inverters, wind power converters, charging piles, battery swapping cabinets, air source heat pumps, energy gateways, and cloud management platforms). The company also engages in EPC and BT business models for photovoltaic and energy storage projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced power electronics and energy efficiency management technologies, including high-frequency modular UPS systems, active neutral point clamped (ANPC) three-level inverter topologies, digital signal processing, and integrated product development (IPD). It emphasizes intelligent manufacturing with automated production lines, precision quality control, and extensive R&D in battery management systems, energy management systems, and liquid cooling technologies for energy storage. The company also develops sodium-ion battery technology and advanced charging infrastructure with liquid cooling and intelligent power distribution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: East Group serves a broad range of industries including finance, telecommunications, government, internet, transportation, healthcare, and industrial sectors. Key customers include major state-owned enterprises and large corporations such as China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom, China Petroleum, State Grid, Southern Power Grid, and various energy and infrastructure companies. The company’s products are widely used in data centers, 5G base stations, renewable energy projects, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and industrial automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive domestic coverage including Guangdong, Guangxi, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Henan, Gansu, Xinjiang, and other provinces. It also actively expands overseas markets, particularly in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East, through OEM and proprietary brand sales. The company maintains over 260 customer service centers globally and participates in international exhibitions to enhance its global presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: East Group operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power electronics and new energy supply chain. It manufactures core components and systems such as UPS, inverters, energy storage systems, and charging infrastructure, while also engaging in project development, EPC contracting, and asset operation in photovoltaic and energy storage sectors. The company maintains direct procurement relationships with suppliers and manages a comprehensive supply chain to ensure quality and timely delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in power electronics, energy storage, and intelligent energy management, with significant R&D investment (7.92% of revenue in 2024). It focuses on developing high-efficiency, high-reliability products such as modular UPS, sodium-ion batteries, liquid-cooled energy storage systems, and advanced charging piles. The company integrates AI technologies for product development and operational optimization, pursues digital transformation, and expands its product portfolio to meet emerging demands in AI computing, 5G, renewable energy, and electric vehicles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of UPS systems, photovoltaic inverters, energy storage products, and electric vehicle charging equipment. Additional income streams include EPC and BT project contracting, energy station operation and asset management, technology services, and licensing. The company also earns government subsidies and investment income from equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: East Group is positioned as a leading domestic player in high-end power electronics, data center infrastructure, and new energy solutions, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a top 500 global new energy company. It competes with other major Chinese and international manufacturers in UPS, energy storage, photovoltaic, and charging infrastructure markets. The company emphasizes technological leadership, comprehensive system solutions, and strong customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.04 billion, a 36.49% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 189 million, down 66.38%. Total assets stood at RMB 12.06 billion with net assets of RMB 6.84 billion. Despite recent revenue and profit declines due to project delivery delays and asset disposals, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in R&D and capacity expansion. Overseas revenue grew by 6.97% in 2024, reflecting ongoing international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: East Group differentiates itself through advanced power electronics technology, high reliability, energy efficiency, and intelligent management capabilities. Its products feature high conversion efficiency (up to 99.01% for photovoltaic inverters), superior power quality, robust fault ride-through capabilities, and modular, scalable designs. The company offers integrated system solutions tailored to diverse customer needs across multiple industries, supported by extensive R&D, strong intellectual property, and comprehensive after-sales service. Its focus on sustainable energy, digital transformation, and AI-enabled innovation positions it as a trusted partner in the evolving energy and digital infrastructure landscape.
